summary: Installs catch missing network setup up front, and the install command is shorter.

new.title: Private install checks everything before starting
new.text: A private network install now checks your networks and DNS zones first. Anything missing is listed in plain words, and nothing is created until you fix it.

new.title: Shorter install command
new.text: The install command now needs only your tenant and subscription. The region is West Europe unless you choose another.

new.title: Support scripts come with a full guide
new.text: The support scripts on invardia.com come with a guide: the install commands and every script with its documentation page and checksum.
